column1: # vcpkg's OWN host tools, pinned from its scripts/vcpkg-tools.json at the
# Separate from vcpkg_assets.tsv because the asset capture CANNOT see
# these: vcpkg_find_acquire_program probes the host first, so a tool the
# capturing machine already has is never downloaded and never captured.
# That is how ninja went unpinned -- the capturing machine had
# /usr/bin/ninja at exactly the required version -- while cmake was pinned
# only because the host's was too old. What a pin contains must not depend
# on what happens to be installed on one machine.
